bias.en: Pullback · lost the 100-day, above the 200-day and SAR
bias.zh: 回调 · 跌破 100 日均线，位于 200 日均线和 SAR 上方

read.en: Palantir fell 4.5% on Nov 16 to $160.39, trading $158.68–166.09. It is below the 5-day ($168.2), 10-day ($167.3), 30-day ($186.9) and 100-day ($167.2), and above the 200-day ($153.8, rising). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16, below zero, histogram widening slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($153.94), and RSI is 34.9.
read.zh: Palantir 11月16日下跌 4.5%，收于 $160.39，盘中区间 $158.68–166.09。股价位于 5 日（$168.2）、10 日（$167.3）、30 日（$186.9）和 100 日均线（$167.2）下方，位于 200 日均线（$153.8，上行）上方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图小幅放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$153.94），RSI 为 34.9。

read.en: The drop broke the 100-day and the $164–166.7 support (Nov 10, Sep 10 and Nov 13 lows), now resistance; the $158.68 low held above the Nov 6 low ($157.24). Resistance is $164–166.1, then $167.2–168.2 (100, 10 and 5-day) and $170.8–172.4. Support is $157.2–158.7, then $153.8–153.9 (200-day, SAR) and $152.6 (Nov 5 low). A close above $166.1 would target $167–168; below $157.2, $153.8–153.9.

r.en: Nov 10 low $164, Sep 10 low $164.55 and Nov 13 low $164.75, lost; Nov 16 high $166.09
Nov 11 low $170.80; Nov 12 close $171.58; Nov 11 close $172.40
